chapterInfo.content:
22
Onyankopɔn hyɛ Abraham sɛ ɔmfa Isak mmɔ afɔreɛ
1 # Heb 11.17; Yak 1.12 Na nsɛm yi akyiri no, Onyankopɔn sɔɔ Abraham hwɛe, na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Abraham! Na ɔse: Menie. 2#2 Be 3.1 Na ɔkaa sɛ: Fa wo ba, wo ba korɔ a wodɔ no, Isak, kɔ Moria asase so, na fa no kɔbɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ wɔ hɔ, wɔ mmepɔ no mu baako a mɛkyerɛ woɔ so.
3Na Abraham sɔree anɔpatutu, na ɔhyehyɛɛ n’afunumu, na ɔfaa n’asomfoɔ mu baanu ne ne ba Isak kaa ne ho, na ɔtwaa ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ nnyina, na ɔsii mu kɔɔ faako a Onyankopɔn kyerɛɛ no no. 4Na da a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa no, Abraham maa n’ani so, na ɔhunuu beaeɛ hɔ wɔ akyirikyiri. 5Na Abraham ka kyerɛɛ ne somfoɔ no sɛ: Mo ne afunumu yi ntena ha; na me ne abarimaa yi bɛkɔ nohoa akɔsɔre, na yɛasane aba mo nkyɛn. 6Na Abraham faa ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ nnyina no de soaa ne ba Isak, na ɔfaa ogya ne sekan kurae, na wɔn baanu kɔe. 7Na Isak ka kyerɛɛ n’agya Abraham sɛ: M’agya! Na ɔse: Menie, me ba. Na ɔse: Hwɛ, ogya ne nnyina nie, na adwammaa a wɔde rekɔbɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ no wɔ he? 8Na Abraham se: Me ba, Onyankopɔn ankasa bɛkyerɛ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ adwammaa no. Na wɔn baanu kɔe. 9Na wɔkɔduruu deɛ Onyankopɔn kyerɛɛ no hɔ, na Abraham sii afɔrebukyia wɔ hɔ, na ɔsiesiee nnyina no, na ɔkyekyeree ne ba Isak, na ɔde no too afɔrebukyia no so wɔ nnyina no so. 10#Yak 2.21 Afei Abraham tenee ne nsa faa sekan no sɛ ɔde rebɛkum ne ba no.
11Na AWURADE bɔfoɔ firi soro frɛɛ no sɛ: Abraham, Abraham! Na ɔse: Menie. 12#Yer 7.31; Rom 8.32 Na ɔse: Mfa wo nsa nka abarimaa no, nso nyɛ no hwee. Afei na mahunu sɛ wosuro Onyankopɔn, na woankame me wo ba korɔ no.
13Na Abraham maa n’ani so, na ɔhunuu odwennini a dɔtɔ asɔ ne mmɛn mu wɔ n’akyi. Na Abraham kɔfaa odwennini no de no sii ne ba no ananmu bɔɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ.
14Na Abraham too bea hɔ din sɛ: Yahwe-yir’e.#22.14 YAHWE-YIR’E: Asekyerɛ ne: AWURADE bɛhwɛ. Enti wɔka no nnɛ ara sɛ: AWURADE bepɔ so na wɔbɛhwɛ.
15Na AWURADE bɔfoɔ firi soro frɛɛ Abraham bio sɛ: 16#Heb 6.13 Sɛ AWURADE seɛ nie: Ɛsiane sɛ woayɛ saa asɛm yi, na woankame me wo ba korɔ no nti, maka me ho ntam sɛ: 17#Gye 13.16; 15.5; Heb 11.12; Gye 24.60 Hyira na mɛhyira woɔ, na dɔ na mɛma w’asefoɔ adɔre sɛ ɔsoro nsoromma ne mpoano anwea. Na w’asefoɔ bɛfa wɔn atamfoɔ nkuro ano apono adi so. 18#Gye 12.3; Gal 3.16 Na w’asefoɔ mu na wɔbɛhyira asase so amanaman nyinaa, ɛfiri sɛ woatie me nne. 19Ɛnna Abraham sane baa ne mmeranteɛ no nkyɛn, na wɔsɔre sii mu baa Beer-seba. Na Abraham tenaa Beer-seba.
Nahor asefoɔ
20 # Gye 11.29 Na nsɛm yi akyiri no, wɔka kyerɛɛ Abraham sɛ: Hwɛ, Milka nso awo mma ama wo nua Nahor: 21N’abakan Us ne ne nua Bus ne Kemuel a ɔyɛ Aram agya, 22ne Kesed ne Haso ne Pildas ne Yidlaf ne Betuel. 23#Gye 24.15 Na Betuel woo Rebeka. Nnipa baawɔtwe yi na Milka wo maa Abraham nua Nahor. 24Na ne mpena baako bi a wɔfrɛ no Rehuma nso woo Teba, Gaham, Tahas ne Maaka.

Na nsɛm yi akyiri no, Onyankopɔn sɔɔ Abraham hwɛe, na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Abraham! Na ɔse: Menie. Na ɔkaa sɛ: Fa wo ba, wo ba korɔ a wodɔ no, Isak, kɔ Moria asase so, na fa no kɔbɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ wɔ hɔ, wɔ mmepɔ no mu baako a mɛkyerɛ woɔ so.
Na Abraham sɔree anɔpatutu, na ɔhyehyɛɛ n’afunumu, na ɔfaa n’asomfoɔ mu baanu ne ne ba Isak kaa ne ho, na ɔtwaa ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ nnyina, na ɔsii mu kɔɔ faako a Onyankopɔn kyerɛɛ no no. Na da a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa no, Abraham maa n’ani so, na ɔhunuu beaeɛ hɔ wɔ akyirikyiri. Na Abraham ka kyerɛɛ ne somfoɔ no sɛ: Mo ne afunumu yi ntena ha; na me ne abarimaa yi bɛkɔ nohoa akɔsɔre, na yɛasane aba mo nkyɛn. Na Abraham faa ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ nnyina no de soaa ne ba Isak, na ɔfaa ogya ne sekan kurae, na wɔn baanu kɔe. Na Isak ka kyerɛɛ n’agya Abraham sɛ: M’agya! Na ɔse: Menie, me ba. Na ɔse: Hwɛ, ogya ne nnyina nie, na adwammaa a wɔde rekɔbɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ no wɔ he? Na Abraham se: Me ba, Onyankopɔn ankasa bɛkyerɛ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ adwammaa no. Na wɔn baanu kɔe. Na wɔkɔduruu deɛ Onyankopɔn kyerɛɛ no hɔ, na Abraham sii afɔrebukyia wɔ hɔ, na ɔsiesiee nnyina no, na ɔkyekyeree ne ba Isak, na ɔde no too afɔrebukyia no so wɔ nnyina no so. Afei Abraham tenee ne nsa faa sekan no sɛ ɔde rebɛkum ne ba no.
Na AWURADE bɔfoɔ firi soro frɛɛ no sɛ: Abraham, Abraham! Na ɔse: Menie. Na ɔse: Mfa wo nsa nka abarimaa no, nso nyɛ no hwee. Afei na mahunu sɛ wosuro Onyankopɔn, na woankame me wo ba korɔ no.
Na Abraham maa n’ani so, na ɔhunuu odwennini a dɔtɔ asɔ ne mmɛn mu wɔ n’akyi. Na Abraham kɔfaa odwennini no de no sii ne ba no ananmu bɔɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ.
Na Abraham too bea hɔ din sɛ: Yahwe-yir’e. Enti wɔka no nnɛ ara sɛ: AWURADE bepɔ so na wɔbɛhwɛ.
Na AWURADE bɔfoɔ firi soro frɛɛ Abraham bio sɛ: Sɛ AWURADE seɛ nie: Ɛsiane sɛ woayɛ saa asɛm yi, na woankame me wo ba korɔ no nti, maka me ho ntam sɛ: Hyira na mɛhyira woɔ, na dɔ na mɛma w’asefoɔ adɔre sɛ ɔsoro nsoromma ne mpoano anwea. Na w’asefoɔ bɛfa wɔn atamfoɔ nkuro ano apono adi so. Na w’asefoɔ mu na wɔbɛhyira asase so amanaman nyinaa, ɛfiri sɛ woatie me nne. Ɛnna Abraham sane baa ne mmeranteɛ no nkyɛn, na wɔsɔre sii mu baa Beer-seba. Na Abraham tenaa Beer-seba.

Na nsɛm yi akyiri no, wɔka kyerɛɛ Abraham sɛ: Hwɛ, Milka nso awo mma ama wo nua Nahor: N’abakan Us ne ne nua Bus ne Kemuel a ɔyɛ Aram agya, ne Kesed ne Haso ne Pildas ne Yidlaf ne Betuel. Na Betuel woo Rebeka. Nnipa baawɔtwe yi na Milka wo maa Abraham nua Nahor. Na ne mpena baako bi a wɔfrɛ no Rehuma nso woo Teba, Gaham, Tahas ne Maaka.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
